Do you often misplace or lose your phone? Then Find My Phone by Clap Launcher is the perfect app for you! Find My Phone by Clap Launcher is a smart device finder designed to help you quickly locate a missing phone simply by clapping or whistling. When you clap or whistle, your phone will make a sound, vibrate, and flash, making it easy to find your device in seconds.

Please note: As a launcher app, the layout of your home screen may change after install. Don’t worry, all your apps are still on your phone, they just may be in a different location. To learn more, please visit our FAQ section: https://findmyphonelauncher.com/#faq

With Find My Phone Launcher, you get the added benefits of:

🚀 One-swipe access - Activate the clap & whistle detector instantly with just one swipe from your home screen!

📱 Home screen widget - See the time, weather, and more, conveniently on your home screen with our customized widget.

🖼️ Wallpaper – Personalize your home or lock screen with a wide selection of beautiful themed wallpapers.

🏠 Home screen shortcut – Use the Find My Phone Launcher shortcut on your home screen to enjoy quick access.

🔍 Multi-touchpoint search – Apps and web search has never been easier. Search for installed apps or the web (powered by Google, Brave, and Yahoo!) from multiple access points.

Key free features
✓ Clap or whistle to find phone
✓ Flashlight and vibration alerts
✓ Customizable alert sounds and duration
✓ Battery efficient and optimized for performance

👏 Find my phone by clap or whistle
Start clapping or whistling to activate advanced sound recognition. Our sound recognition technology helps you locate your device in seconds, even if it is in the next room.

💡 Multi alert system
When activated, Find My Phone by Clap Launcher triggers a powerful combination of loud ringtones and bright flashing lights. This makes your phone easy to spot whether it is hidden under pillows, behind furniture, or in a dark corner.

⚡ Bright flash and vibration response
The flashlight and vibration make it easy to locate your phone even in noisy or low light environments.

🎵 Customizable alerts
Choose from a variety of attention grabbing sounds. Select from soothing melodies, whistles, playful animal sounds, or modern electronic tones. Adjust volume levels to suit your environment.

⏰ Set alert duration
Control how long your phone rings when activated. Choose from 10, 30, 60, or 120 seconds.

🔋 Battery friendly design
Find My Phone by Clap Launcher is optimized for minimal battery consumption while running in the background, so your phone is always ready without unnecessary drain.

✨ Easy to use
Enjoy a seamless experience with a simple and intuitive interface. No complicated setup required.

📲 Versatile compatibility
Works across multiple phone models and functions whether your phone is on silent, vibrate, or full volume.

Find My Phone by Clap Launcher is an efficient phone finder that gives you the power to locate your device in seconds. Download now and never worry about losing your phone again.

If you have any questions, feedback, or feature suggestions, feel free to write to us. You can uninstall the app at any time.
